indication: Preventing stretch marks
stage_specific_assessment: During pregnancy, check ingredients, especially retinoids. Stop irritating products. Prevention studies give little information about uncommon adverse effects.

indication: Oral collagen and skin elasticity
stage_specific_assessment: Before conception, adult cosmetic findings apply only to similar populations. During pregnancy and lactation, product-specific safety and benefit for this indication remain unestablished.

indication: Treating existing striae and loose skin
stage_specific_assessment: Defer elective procedures during pregnancy. Later assessment must account for healing, site, skin type and lactation. RF microneedling has a device-specific FDA harm warning.

indication: Diastasis, strength and abdominal function
stage_specific_assessment: The exercise trial does not establish immediate postpartum readiness. Wound problems, pain and pelvic heaviness warrant individual assessment.

indication: Binders, hernia and persistent laxity
stage_specific_assessment: After cesarean, clinician review of incision, fit and symptoms is appropriate. Rectus diastasis, hernia and wound separation require different evaluations.

indication: Breast changes, support and feeding choices
stage_specific_assessment: Support may be chosen across stages for comfort. A cosmetic procedure during recovery or lactation needs specialist assessment. Do not frame formula, breastfeeding or combined feeding as a cosmetic intervention.

indication: Conditioning before conception
stage_specific_assessment: Before conception, avoid imposing trial weight-loss programs on general users. Once pregnant use pregnancy-specific exercise guidance.

indication: Exercise and gestational weight gain
stage_specific_assessment: Across trimesters adapt for comfort, balance and medical conditions. Stop and seek care for bleeding, painful contractions or fluid leakage. No calorie-deficit goal.

indication: Returning to lifting, walking and running
stage_specific_assessment: Immediate recovery after uncomplicated vaginal birth differs from major tearing, assisted birth, cesarean or medical complications. Progress individually in every pathway.

indication: Pelvic floor, leakage and sexual comfort
stage_specific_assessment: During pregnancy or recovery, supervision is useful for pain or difficulty contracting/relaxing. Discuss contraception before sex if pregnancy is undesired, including while breastfeeding.

indication: Perineal injury, labor support and birth choices
stage_specific_assessment: Antenatal measures belong in late pregnancy with maternity-team advice. Intrapartum techniques require consent. Compare planned vaginal, assisted and cesarean pathways with individual clinical indications and preferences.

indication: Folate, food and prenatal nutrient needs
stage_specific_assessment: Review diet, existing supplements, deficiencies, interactions and overlapping products with the clinician. Avoid excessive preformed vitamin A. Choose lower-mercury fish using FDA species guidance. Review lactation needs separately.

indication: Ginger, probiotics, creatine and supplement quality
stage_specific_assessment: Culinary intake differs from concentrated products. Do not infer rare fetal safety from short trials. Report product, timing and symptoms to clinician. Third-party testing addresses aspects of product quality, not clinical benefit.

indication: Acne, pigmentation and sun protection
stage_specific_assessment: Review retinoids before trying. Contact the prescriber promptly about any pregnancy exposure, distinguishing oral from topical. Check lactation and infant contact separately for each treatment.

indication: Hair shedding and nail changes
stage_specific_assessment: Medication decisions differ in pregnancy and lactation. Minoxidil needs a product- and infant-specific assessment. Typical postpartum shedding does not establish deficiency.

indication: Wound recovery and later scar care
stage_specific_assessment: Immediate postpartum: wound and infection assessment. Following closure: discuss silicone or scar therapy if symptomatic. Delay massage or elective devices until healing is assessed. Severe bleeding or systemic illness needs urgent care.

indication: Swelling, varicose veins and blood-clot warning signs
stage_specific_assessment: Pregnancy and postpartum: urgent symptoms override comfort advice. A stocking is not a diagnostic test or a substitute for prescribed thromboprophylaxis. Later vein procedures require vascular review.

indication: Back, pelvic girdle, balance and foot changes
stage_specific_assessment: Antenatal treatment should be adapted to pregnancy by trained clinicians. Persistent postpartum pain or impaired mobility should prompt reassessment; provocative self-testing is unnecessary.

indication: Planning, fertility, medication and vaccines
stage_specific_assessment: Do not stop needed medicines independently. Some vaccines belong before conception, others during pregnancy. Local schedules, products and seasonal timing need current clinical review.

indication: Mental health, rest and partner support
stage_specific_assessment: During pregnancy and the year after delivery, thoughts of harming oneself or the baby need immediate help. Severe confusion or loss of contact with reality requires emergency assessment. Postpartum follow-up is an ongoing process.

indication: Oral health and periodontal treatment
stage_specific_assessment: Preventive, diagnostic and necessary restorative treatment may be provided during pregnancy according to ADA guidance. Individual medications and medical complications need coordination.

indication: Traditional therapies and elective devices
stage_specific_assessment: No home procedure instructions. FDA reports serious injuries with certain RF microneedling uses. Specialist review is needed after healing and during lactation; regulatory clearance depends on device and indication.
